answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake for a full epoch, slashed if two identities are proven to share an operator, keys, or output. Like a trellis that only holds vines rooted in real soil, this makes mass fakery costly: each sybil needs its own stake, not just a copied profile. New identities start in a shallow lagoon of trust with low transaction limits, and only reach the jetty of higher limits after a history of attested, paid work. An attacker must therefore fund and risk losing a stake per fake agent, pushing sybil cost above the gain from fake votes or spam.
